html:
/* Template:ImageSplit/styles.css - text on the left, a picture on the right that is cropped to the height of the text. */
.aa-split {
	display: flex;
	align-items: stretch;
	gap: 16px;
	margin: 0.4em 0 1em;
}
.aa-split-main {
	flex: 1 1 0;
	min-width: 0;
}
.aa-split-pic {
	position: relative;
	flex: 0 0 34%;
	min-height: 220px;
	border: 1px solid var(--aa-edge, rgba(247, 240, 233, .12));
	border-radius: 10px;
	overflow: hidden;
	background: var(--aa-card, rgba(35, 30, 26, .8));
}
.aa-split-pic a,
.aa-split-pic span,
.aa-split-pic img {
	position: absolute;
	top: 0;
	left: 0;
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	height: 100%;
}
.aa-split-pic img {
	object-fit: cover;
	object-position: 55% 40%;
}
/* the first paragraph and the grid sit flush with the top and bottom of the picture */
.aa-split-main > :first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.aa-split-main > :last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
@media (max-width: 800px) {
	.aa-split { flex-direction: column; }
	.aa-split-pic { flex: none; height: 240px; min-height: 0; }
}
